title: Typed-message variants (double space, texting spellings) evade every crisis pattern
scenario: On a phone the user types 'me quiero  morir' (two spaces), 'me qiero morir' or 'ya no kiero vivir'. elegirModo returns 'escuchar' because normalizar only lowercases and strips accents, and every signal uses literal single spaces.

title: The dose check has no echo exemption, so in crisis a reply urging emergency care after an overdose is replaced
scenario: The user writes 'Me tomé 20 pastillas y ya no quiero vivir' (crisis). The model replies 'Si tomaste 20 pastillas necesitas ayuda ya: llama a emergencias o pide a alguien de confianza que te lleve. ¿Estás a salvo en este momento?'. This reply passes cumpleCrisis. nombraMedicamento still returns true
fix: Let a dose match through when the exact dose string also appears in dicho (the same word-bounded echo rule used for names), at least in CRISIS mode. Or add 'emergencias' to the crisis line for ingestion signals.

title: When a session ends on an assistant turn and the last user message is long, extraction drops the user's words
scenario: The user sends a long final message (about 8,800 or more characters, e.g. a pasted letter), Nadie replies, and the session closes. extract(memory/checkin/share-summary) builds its transcript with recortar. The window contains only Nadie's final reply, because the user turn does not fit and the 'star
fix: In recortar, make sure the last user turn is always included, truncated to the budget if needed, rather than only the last message. Alternatively, trim extraction transcripts so they end on the last user turn.

title: A single oversized user message is never truncated, so the turn throws a context overflow outside crisis mode
scenario: The user pastes a 15,000-character text. recortar keeps the last message whole ('aunque solo él se pase'). WebLLM 0.2.85 throws ContextWindowSizeExceededError when prompt tokens exceed the 4096 window. completar rejects and, in escuchar, pensar and limite, chat() rethrows, so the turn errors instead
fix: Truncate the last message to PRESUPUESTO_HISTORIAL characters and keep its tail, which is where the latest content is. Then no single message can exceed the budget. Add a test with a 20k-character message.
